youtube_description:
The Harry Potter cast are actually pretty bad at Harry Potter trivia - we asked The Weasley Twins and Warwick Davies aka Professor Flitwick at the Gringotts Wizarding Bank expansion at the Warner Bros Studio Tour London launch, about all the Harry Potter trivia you should know - from the seven Horcruxes to the names of the ghosts at Hogwarts - and let's just say the results weren't good!
